observations: Three photos show a black TV stand with a glass top, two tall floor-standing speakers, and a wall-mounted TV.
The TV stand has multiple drawers and open shelves, with silver handles and a glossy black finish.
The speakers are tall, black, with visible drivers: two mid-range and one large woofer at the bottom, each with a silver ring around the woofer.
The TV is wall-mounted, black, and appears to be a flat-screen model, but no brand or model is visible.
The setup is in a room with tiled walls and floor; cables are visible running from the TV and electronics to the stand.
Photo 0 and 1 are front-facing views; photo 2 is a side view showing the depth of the stand and speakers.
No visible damage to the stand or speakers in the photos, but no close-ups of surfaces or connections.
The seller claims it is an 'LG Home Theatre System', but no LG branding is visible on any component in the photos.

identity.kind: home theatre system with glass top TV stand

claims.evidence: No LG branding is visible on any component in the photos. The seller's text alone does not prove the brand.
Photo 0 and 1 show a glossy black top surface consistent with glass, reflecting light and objects above it.

risks.risk: The home theatre system may not be an LG brand as claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the front or back of the central unit or speakers showing the brand name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic home theatre system, not an LG, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The speakers or central unit may be non-functional or missing components.
risks.proof: A video showing the system powered on, with sound output, or a close-up of all ports and connections.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, or with missing parts, reducing value significantly.

risks.risk: The glass top may be cracked or chipped, not visible in current photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the glass top surface, especially edges and corners.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The TV stand may have internal damage or missing drawers.
risks.proof: A photo showing the inside of the drawers and the structure of the stand.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly damaged or incomplete, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the central unit or speakers showing the brand name.
Video or photo of the system powered on with sound output.
Close-up photo of the glass top surface, especially edges and corners.
Photo showing the inside of the drawers and the structure of the stand.
response.reason: The seller claims it is an LG home theatre system, but no branding is visible in the photos. The system's functionality and condition cannot be confirmed without closer inspection. The glass top and stand structure also need verification for damage. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately.
